A [[human]] [[Gender|female]] '''individual''' worked as a [[farmer]] in a [[Unidentified farm village|village]] during the [[Imperial Era]], alongside her [[Unidentified village brother|brother]]. During her [[time]] in the village, the sister was saved from falling bales of harvested crops by [[Great Jedi Purge|Jedi Purge]] survivor [[Ahsoka Tano]], who was living and working in the village under the alias "Ashla." The sister saw Tano immediately afterward and realized she had used [[the Force]] to save her life. Grateful, the sister made friendly overtures towards Tano, inviting her to eat with the others during a meal. That night, the sister approached Tano and revealed that she knew her secret, promising to keep quiet about it. However, her brother overheard the conversation and, being a supporter of the [[Galactic Empire]], decided to report Tano in the hopes of reward.<ref name="Resolve" />

Tano and the sister went away on an errand the next day, delivering harvested crops to [[Mon-Hella]]. When they returned, they found that the village had been [[Attack on a farm village|destroyed]] by the [[Eleventh Brother]], who was holding the brother and an [[Unidentified old man (Ahsoka Tano)|old man]] hostage. Tano defeated and [[Death|killed]] the [[Inquisitor]], and the sister, while relieved that her brother was still alive, was also angry with him for his actions. As the three survivors had to leave the area, Tano used a [[comlink]] she had been given to contact [[Alderaanian]] [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], who came in the [[corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' to pick them up.<ref name="Resolve" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
The village sister is shown be nice and friendly to others. She also doesn't take to her brother ignoring warnings from her and others and is also against the Empire. When she learned that Ashla was a Jedi who survived Order 66, she was grateful towards her and promise to keep her secret. However, when her brother reported Ashla to the Empire, she was horrified to see her home destroyed because her brother wanting a reward. Even though her brother was saved, she was disappointed in him for calling the empire that led to the death of their friends and home getting destroy.<ref name="Resolve" />
==Behind the scenes==
The village sister was voiced by [[Dana Davis]].<ref name="Resolve" />
